_about: Machine-readable twin of claude-toolkit.md. The knowledge-library plugin's SessionStart hook reads it, detects the project type from files in the working folder, and tells each session which plugins and connectors to use and which to leave off. Edit the doc and this file together.

use: knowledge-library plugin (status, filing back)
context7 for current library docs (never put client code or secrets in a query)
/commit from commit-commands at milestones
built-in browser pane for checking your own pages
avoid: Linear, HubSpot connectors (not part of this work; write access)
brightdata-plugin (paid scraping; its skill tries to replace all web tools)
desktop-commander (full shell and file access, not needed)
workflows / ultracode / fast mode unless the user asks
Claude in Chrome unless a logged-in dashboard is needed

profiles.label: Flutter app
use: dart-flutter plugin skills (tests, responsive layout, layout fixes, go_router, l10n) and its bundled Dart MCP (hot reload, runtime errors)
starters/flutter-app and playbooks/mobile-app.md from the library

install.dart-flutter@dart-flutter: claude plugin marketplace add flutter/skills && claude plugin install dart-flutter@dart-flutter --scope user

avoid: Playwright / Chrome DevTools MCP (not a web project)
Supabase connector unless the app uses Supabase
a second, hand-added Dart MCP (`claude mcp add dart …`): the plugin already brings one

profiles.label: Firebase
use: Firebase MCP only if needed, pinned version, `--only crashlytics` for read-mostly work

profiles.label: Cloudflare site/Worker
use: cloudflare plugin skills (Workers, wrangler, Turnstile, web-perf)
the claude.ai Cloudflare connector with a token limited to this account
avoid: authenticating the cloudflare plugin's own MCP: the claude.ai connector already covers it

profiles.label: Supabase
use: Supabase connector with read_only=true and this project's project_ref only; never client production data

profiles.label: Shopify store/theme
use: Shopify connector
shopify-ai-toolkit plugin (read its hooks before installing)

profiles.label: Website / web app
use: typescript-lsp (works with the project's own node_modules/typescript)
ONE browser MCP for tests: Playwright (--isolated) or Chrome DevTools, not both
searchfit-seo / marketing skills for SEO and copy
library playbooks for the site type

profiles.label: Vercel deploy
use: vercel plugin with VERCEL_PLUGIN_TELEMETRY=off

profiles.label: Stripe payments
use: Stripe MCP in a test account only; check UAE gateways (Telr, Network International, Tap)

profiles.label: Video (Remotion / HyperFrames)
use: motion-design-styles.md (domains/social-media): pick ONE of the 20 graphic styles per series, write a style sheet (palette, fonts, textures, motion, easing) before building, build with code; Persian/Arabic text always by code with Vazirmatn; log the result with 🔬 under that style
remotion or hyperframes plugin skills
GSAP skills
multilang-video-pipeline doc; Persian voice: Higgs v3 (non-commercial) or MOSS with a long reference
avoid: Runway/Higgsfield credits unless the user asks

profiles.label: Social media content
use: motion-design-styles.md (domains/social-media): pick ONE of the 20 graphic styles per series, write a style sheet (palette, fonts, textures, motion, easing) before building, build with code; Persian/Arabic text always by code with Vazirmatn; log the result with 🔬 under that style
Canva connector
instagram-agent skills (never ig-human on fa/ar)
marketing skills
Buffer or Metricool for scheduling (one), every publish approved by the user
avoid: postiz publishing without the user's approval

profiles.label: Knowledge library itself
use: kl-researcher / kl-verifier / kl-curator agents
/kl-review, /kl-add, /kl-status
scripts/build_all.py before every commit
